_about: Synthetic 'Jordan Lee' fixtures for the §13 agent reasoning golden set (AC5 — no real user data). Each key is a case id from cases.jsonl; its value is the concrete, structured input the matching per-agent runner feeds to the REAL prompt module via the LLM gateway. Reviewer/gap evidence lines mirror the real retriever format '[source · id · section] content' (src/lib/rag/context.ts); a flag/citation may only reference a source listed in `sources`. These are hand-written scenarios, not model output — the harness tests how the real prompts reason over them.

agt-02-informal-vs-formal.fileText: Notes from talking with the team. Over two weeks I had six quick hallway conversations with staff about the intake form. I asked what annoyed them and jotted the answers on sticky notes. Nothing was scripted or recorded; I just wanted a feel for the pain points before drafting a change.

agt-11-interview-learning-moment.question: Walk me through a decision you made during the billing migration.
agt-11-interview-learning-moment.answer: At first I tried a dual-write between the old and new systems, but it kept drifting out of sync and I was spending every morning reconciling rows. About two weeks in I realised dual-write was the wrong approach, so I switched to a read-repair backfill that reconciled lazily on read. After that the drift dropped to zero and I stopped firefighting.

agt-12-interview-no-learning-moment.question: What did you do on the billing migration?
agt-12-interview-no-learning-moment.answer: I led the migration of the billing system from the legacy platform to the new usage-based one. I coordinated a team of four and we finished it over two quarters, on schedule.
